description: Overlay Maps:OC09 Landslide Hazard is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. The Caboolture ShirePlan commenced on 12 December 2005 and was replaced by the MBRC Planning Scheme on 1 February 2016. Refer to Council website Caboolture ShirePlan (Historic) for more information. Coverage: City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. The portal files it under the publisher City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Its tags are caboolture-shireplan. It offers 11 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, gdb, geojson, gpkg. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
